data.narrative:
Somos is a Series B-stage housing and construction company that has raised $105.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of four private peers in the housing and construction sector—Plantd Materials, Cuby Technologies, Cover, and Charge Robotics—given the absence of direct public comparables in this frontier segment.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised ($106M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage progression, the analysis yields an implied valuation of $201M. This represents the median point in the range and reflects normalized expectation for capital efficiency and growth trajectory at this funding stage.

The full triangulated range spans $171M (low) to $231M (median: $201M), centered on the stage-progression output. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological lens. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 1.9x step-up multiplier absent more granular comp margin and growth-rate data, the stability of private peer valuations as recent reference points, and the degree to which construction-tech fundamentals have shifted post-Series B for this cohort. The analysis is most robust as a stage-based benchmark rather than a market-based valuation anchor.
